description: The screenshot shows DBeaver database IDE on what appears to be Windows, with an SQL editor open in the left pane displaying a query that includes SELECT statements referencing `s_table_name`, `FROM times s LEFT JOIN users u`, and various table fields like `table_size`, `table_rows`, `time_created`. A dark terminal/console window is overlaid on the right side showing execution results with "Resolution:" header followed by date-based entries (like "2022-Jan22 through Sep23 Exclusive") and a summary line reading "Total processed this time - 2 PRE + 14 POST = 16 quarters!". The user appears to be reviewing SQL query execution results, with the database navigator panel visible on the far left showing a tree structure of database objects, and the Windows taskbar visible at the bottom showing the time as 8:56 AM.

The image shows Extended Logic (a database tool) on Windows with a SQL query editor on the left side containing a SELECT query with JOINs against what appears to be table metadata (table_name, table_size, table_rows, time_created columns). On the right side, there's a dark terminal/console window displaying "Breakdown:" followed by execution statistics showing "PRE queries: v1_125_fiscal_l1-h3pAVbH - 2 quarters" and "POST queries: (a22 through fq21 inclusive)" with multiple quarterly entries listed (2022-3q21-4q22, 2022-3q22-4q22, etc.), concluding with "Total processed this time: 2 PRE + 14 POST = 16 queries!". The user appears to be reviewing query execution results in the console output while the SQL code is visible in the editor pane.

The screenshot shows DBeaver database IDE (visible in the window title "DBeaver Lite") on a Windows system with an open SQL query editor. The SQL query visible contains a SELECT statement joining tables with columns like `table_size`, `table_name`, `table_owner`, `time_created`, and references to `pg_size_pretty` function and `all_tables` view, suggesting PostgreSQL database work. On the right side, there's a dark terminal/console window displaying execution results with timestamps (2022-3q/22-4q/22, 2023-2q/23-4q/23) and a summary line stating "Total processed this time - 2 PRE - 14 POST - 16 quarter(s)", indicating a data processing script has completed. The Windows taskbar is visible at the bottom showing the time as 5:48 PM.

The image shows Extended Logic application (visible in title bar) with a SQL query editor on the left side displaying database queries involving table operations like SELECT statements with table_name, table_size, table_rows, and time_created columns, along with pg_size_pretty and pg_relation_size functions. On the right side is a dark terminal/console window showing execution results with a "Breakdown" section listing PRE queries (2 queries) and POST queries (14+ queries) with timestamps from 2022-04-02, ending with a summary line "Total processed this time - 2 PRE + 14 POST = 16 queries". The Windows taskbar is visible at the bottom showing Firefox, File Explorer, and other application icons, indicating this is running on Windows.

The image shows DBeaver database IDE (indicated by "Extended Logic" in the title bar) with an SQL query editor on the left side containing a SELECT statement that references tables with names like "table_size_table_sizes_time_created" and includes syntax highlighting. On the right side is a dark terminal/console output window showing execution breakdown information including "PRE queries: 2 queries", "POST queries: 2622 (through Jul21 inclusive)", and date range entries from 2022-Jul01 to 2023-Jul21, with a final summary line "Total processed this time - 2 PRE + 14 POST = 16 queries". The Windows taskbar is visible at the bottom showing the time as 5:51 AM, and the user appears to be reviewing database query execution results.
